constraints_found.source_line: poll's closed, dinner crew! curry 3, 'surprise me' 1

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: cheapest tier ($). One tier over costs a star
constraints_found.source_line: street-cart prices, please. one step up from that and i'm counting coins the whole walk home

constraints_found.constraint: Light, fresh, clean food. Nothing fried or heavy
constraints_found.source_line: so tonight i need fuel, not a food coma. fresh and clean, please

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian, strict: no meat and no fish (deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: no meat, no fish, just pick and eat...

constraints_found.constraint: Most of the menu should be meat-free, so she gets a real choice (preference)
constraints_found.source_line: if most of tonight's board is like that, i'm happy :)

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance: no cream, yogurt, butter or ghee in the sauce (costs a star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: ...oh. ok, none of that in my sauce. my stomach is still mad about the latte (with brooke's line: a lot of curries are made with cream, yogurt or butter)

venue_assessment.night_market_night_heron: Curry, $, lean and not fried, over half meat-free. But ghee and yogurt are in every pot and can't be left out, so Roxy's dairy intolerance is missed. About 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_marigold_cart: Curry, $, nothing fried, fresh herbs and pickle. 3 of 4 pots vegetarian with their own ladle. Coconut milk and coconut oil, no dairy. Meets every constraint. 3 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_lucky_seven: Curry, $, dairy-free (coconut milk, oil roti). But everything is deep-fried and greasy, which misses Brooke. Only half the board is meat-free, not most, which misses Mina's preference. About 1 star.
venue_assessment.night_market_firefly_lane: Light, vegetarian-friendly and dairy-free, but it's Vietnamese, not curry. Misses the group's craving. About 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_tall_grass: Curry, light, vegetarian with its own paste, coconut milk only. But it's $$, one tier over Maya's budget. About 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_glass_bead: Curry, $, light, but no vegetarian dishes at all (even the pumpkin curry uses dried shrimp paste and the vegetables use chicken stock). Breaks Mina's strict diet. 0 stars.

notes: Each decoy is ruled out by a different constraint (dairy, frying, cuisine, price, strict diet). That's a clean design, and you have to read every review closely.
Roxy's dairy intolerance is hinted, not stated: a latte story, then Brooke's warning about cream, yogurt and butter. Fair, because Brooke spells out the link.

Mina's diet is only stated through a story about sushi day ('no meat, no fish'). It's clear enough, but players could read it as a preference rather than a strict diet. Either way, Glass Bead is ruled out.

Lucky Seven's 'half of the board' versus Marigold's '3 of 4' and Night Heron's 'over half' makes the 'most of the board' preference a fine-grained call. Lucky Seven fails on frying anyway, so the pick doesn't depend on it.
Marigold Cart serves a fish curry. A strict vegetarian could worry about cross-contact, but the review covers it: the vegetarian pots get their own ladle. Fair.
Nothing looked contradictory. Marigold is the only venue that clears every constraint.
